title: Literature Evidence Review
description: Search Europe PMC with an explicit bounded strategy and return source-linked publication metadata and abstracts for evidence synthesis.

tools.name: literature_search_preview
tools.description: Search Europe PMC for up to ten publications and return exact query provenance, source relevance order, identifiers, publication types, and bounded abstracts. Cite PMID, PMCID, DOI, or Europe PMC URL when synthesizing.

query.description: Europe PMC free-text or fielded query, preferably in English.

tools.name: literature_review_collect
tools.description: Collect and persist an approved Europe PMC evidence map with up to 25 source-ordered publications, abstracts, identifiers, filters, manifest, and interpretation limits.
